description: Designing, querying, or troubleshooting the Health Cloud consent data model — the five-object HIPAA authorization hierarchy (DataUsePurpose → AuthorizationForm → AuthorizationFormText → AuthorizationFormDataUse → AuthorizationFormConsent). Trigger keywords: authorization form consent, ConsentGiverId, AuthorizationFormConsent SOQL, CareProgramEnrollee consent gate, PHI consent trail, consent hierarchy setup. NOT for the Setup configuration of authorization forms, consent templates, and withdrawal handling — use admin/health-cloud-consent-management. NOT for marketing or GDPR opt-out on ContactPointTypeConsent — use security/gdpr-data-privacy.
inputs: Target org with Health Cloud enabled
Patient Individual ID (not Contact ID) for ConsentGiverId population
List of data use purposes mapped to clinical workflows (e.g., treatment, research)
Intake flow or process that captures patient authorization signature
name: consent-data-model-health
official_sources: AuthorizationForm: API 46.0+, available if Data Protection and Privacy is enabled; `DefaultAuthFormTextId`, `EffectiveFromDate`, `EffectiveToDate`, `IsSignatureRequired`, `RevisionNumber`; share and owner sharing rule objects (L45946-46075).

AuthorizationFormConsent: `AuthorizationFormTextId` ("the authorization form text that the Individual consented to"), `ConsentCapturedDateTime`, `ConsentCapturedSource` (string), `ConsentCapturedSourceType` (restricted picklist Email, InPerson, MailingAddress, Phone, Social, Video, Web), `ConsentGiverId` polymorphic to Account, Contact, Individual, Lead, User, `DocumentVersionId`, required `Name`, `RelatedRecordId`, `Status` restricted picklist Rejected, Seen, Signed (L46076-46293).

DataUsePurpose: API 45.0+, `CanDataSubjectOptOut`, `LegalBasisId`, `Name`, `PurposeId` (L95156-95290); Contact `IndividualId` (L71768); ContactPointConsent and ContactPointTypeConsent descriptions (L7662-7679, L74028-74031); restricted picklists reject unapproved values through the API (L2463-2464).

Apex Developer Guide (`salesforce_apex_developer_guide.txt`): polymorphic `What.Type` filtering (L9780-9786); lookup fields indexed by default (L9643-9645). Apex Reference Guide (`salesforce_apex_reference_guide.txt`): `Id.getSObjectType()` (L217368-217372).
outputs: Configured five-object consent hierarchy with at least one AuthorizationFormConsent record per enrolled patient
SOQL query pattern to verify consent status before PHI access
Checklist of sharing rule gaps that must be addressed separately
